summary: Fireworks for Startups gives eligible startups build credits (amount unpublished) usable for serverless text/vision inference, image generation, STT, embeddings, fine-tuning and on-demand GPU deployments — credits expire 1 year after grant — plus higher rate-limit options, applied-AI expert access and community. Eligibility: registered privately-held for-profit company founded within the last 5 years, venture backed with >$500k funding, pre-Series D.
claim_steps: Fill out the Fireworks for Startups application form (fireworks.ai/startup-program).
Eligibility: registered company <5 years old, VC-backed >$500k, not Series D or later.
On acceptance, credits apply automatically to usage charges; PAYG billing resumes after exhaustion if a payment method is added.

social_proof.title: Fireworks for Startups
social_proof.text: Eligible startups can get access to credits (expire after 1-year) to help you prototype and scale without worrying about upfront costs. Unlock credits and options for higher rate limits. Eligibility: registered company with a functional website, privately held for-profit, founded within the last 5 years, venture backed with >$500k in funding, not Series D or later.
